_comment: The Godot classes view/ uses (A2.2). A class that a used method takes must be listed, or godot-cpp silently drops the method; godot-cpp adds the parents and a few of its own. OS is needed by godot-cpp's own printing; FileAccess reads the catalogue's files (A3.6); RenderingServer takes the crowd's buffers (A3.8) and the look's ground (A4.6); Image makes textures from our own levels (A4.2).
